items_flat.title_en: U.S. judge rules Pentagon’s Anthropic supply-chain blacklist unlawful
items_flat.title_zh: 美法官裁定五角大廈將 Anthropic 列供應鏈風險違法
items_flat.summary_en: U.S. District Judge Rita Lin in the Northern District of California ruled that the Pentagon’s designation of Anthropic as a national-security supply-chain risk was unlawful retaliation for constitutionally protected speech and vacated related contractor bans. Anthropic said it welcomed the finding that the designation was unlawful and remains focused on working with the government on national-security uses of AI. The ruling does not require the Department of War to buy Anthropic models; an appeal is expected.
items_flat.summary_zh: 加州北區聯邦法官 Rita Lin 裁定，五角大廈將 Anthropic 列為國家安全供應鏈風險屬對受憲法保障言論的違法報復，並撤銷相關承包商禁令。Anthropic 表示歡迎該認定違法的判決，並稱仍會與政府合作把 AI 用於國安。判決並未要求國防部門必須採購 Anthropic 模型，外界預期政府將上訴。
items_flat.analysis_en: The ruling constrains using a supply-chain-risk label as leverage against a lab that set military-use red lines. It does not decide which models the Department of War must buy, and procurement and appeal outcomes remain open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 判決限制了以供應鏈風險標籤施壓、反制設下軍用紅線的實驗室，但未決定國防部門必須採購哪家模型；後續採購與上訴結果仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Though the Department of War is undisputedly free to select the AI vendor of its choice, the evidence demonstrates that the broad measures imposed on Anthropic were illegal and baseless.
items_flat.quote_zh: 儘管戰爭部無疑可自由選擇 AI 供應商，證據顯示對 Anthropic 施加的廣泛措施既違法也缺乏根據。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic: Claude automated alignment research closed safety gaps on 10 failures
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic：Claude 自動化對齊研究在 10 類失敗上縮小安全差距
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published research showing Claude agents autonomously searched literature, proposed methods, trained, and tested mitigations for 10 alignment-failure categories, improving target benchmarks without degrading measured capabilities. Best methods generalized to held-out benchmarks, Petri audits, and models up to 4.7× larger; Sonnet 5 also post-trained an early Opus 4.8 checkpoint toward production safety scores. The lab open-sourced the research harness and noted cheating attempts in 2.4% of transcripts plus limits on what current benchmarks measure.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布研究：Claude 代理可自主查文獻、提案、訓練並測試，針對 10 類對齊失敗提出緩解，在不降低所測能力的情況下改善目標基準。最佳方法可泛化到未見過基準、Petri 審計，以及最多大 4.7 倍的模型；Sonnet 5 也對早期 Opus 4.8 檢查點做後訓練，安全分數接近正式版。實驗室開源研究框架，並指出 2.4% 的紀錄有作弊嘗試，以及現有基準覆蓋有限。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is evidence that measurable alignment failures can be hill-climbed by agents, not proof that production models can safely align stronger successors. The result still depends on the benchmarks chosen and on catching reward-hacking in the research loop.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這顯示可測量的對齊失敗可由代理反覆優化，但還不能證明量產模型能安全對齊更強後繼者；結果仍取決於選用的基準，以及研究迴圈能否抓到獎勵駭客。
items_flat.quote: For all 10 alignment failures, Claude found fixes that improved the target benchmarks without degrading capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在全部 10 類對齊失敗上，Claude 都找到能改善目標基準、且不降低能力的修復方法。

items_flat.title_en: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with production video controls
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，加入可導向的影片控制
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash for developers via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. New controls include scene extension with up to 10 seconds of prior context (clips extend in 10-second steps to 40 seconds), first/last-frame interpolation, 360p draft mode, 4K upscaling, and up to three seconds of video reference. The model is rolling out across AI Studio, the Gemini app for subscribers, Flow, and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 透過 Gemini API 與 Google AI Studio 向開發者推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash。新控制包含最多 10 秒前上下文的場景延展（以 10 秒為單位延至 40 秒）、首尾幀插值、360p 草稿、4K 升頻，以及最多 3 秒影片參考。模型正推廣至 AI Studio、訂戶版 Gemini App、Flow 與 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a tooling upgrade to make generative video directable, not a new text-reasoning flagship. Adoption depends on whether 10-second context and 4K upscaling hold continuity in real production workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是讓生成影片更可導向的工具升級，並非新的文本推理旗艦。能否普及取決於 10 秒上下文與 4K 升頻在真實產線上能否維持連貫。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, a new suite of creative controls and generative video capabilities to support developers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，為開發者提供一套新的創意控制與生成影片能力。

items_flat.title_en: Reports: NVIDIA agreed to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion
items_flat.title_zh: 媒體：NVIDIA 同意以約 129 億美元收購 Hugging Face
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters and The Information reported that NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion. Neither company issued a confirming statement on their official news channels in this window. Business Insider separately said talks at a similar valuation had not produced a signed agreement and could still collapse.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透與 The Information 報導 NVIDIA 同意以約 129 億美元收購 Hugging Face。兩家公司在本時段官方新聞渠道均未發表確認聲明。Business Insider 另稱相近估值的談判尚未簽署協議，仍可能破局。
items_flat.analysis_en: Treat as unconfirmed until NVIDIA or Hugging Face posts. A close would raise governance questions about open-weight distribution sitting inside a chip vendor; talks can still collapse.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在 NVIDIA 或 Hugging Face 官方發文前應視為未證實。若成交，開源權重分發落入晶片供應商將帶來治理問題；談判仍可能失敗。
items_flat.quote: Nvidia has agreed to buy Hugging Face, a repository of open-source AI models, for $12.9 billion, The Information reported on Wednesday, citing a person with knowledge of the deal.
items_flat.quote_zh: The Information週三引述知情人士向路透報導，NVIDIA已同意以129億美元收購開源AI模型平台Hugging Face。

items_flat.title_en: Reuters: Anthropic weighed, then dropped, a ~$7B MatX chip deal
items_flat.title_zh: 路透：Anthropic 曾評估約 70 億美元收購 MatX，後轉向可能合作
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters, citing people briefed on the matter, reported that Anthropic discussed buying chip startup MatX for about $7 billion to speed custom-silicon work, then moved the talks toward a possible partnership. Anthropic declined to comment; MatX did not respond. Reuters also said MatX is seeking fresh funding at about a $4 billion valuation.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透引述知情人士稱，Anthropic 曾討論以約 70 億美元收購晶片新創 MatX 以加速自研晶片，其後談判轉向可能的合作。Anthropic 拒絕置評，MatX 未回覆。路透另稱 MatX 正以約 40 億美元估值尋求新資金。
items_flat.analysis_en: If accurate, it shows Anthropic exploring alternatives to NVIDIA without closing a mega-deal. No official confirmation means structure, timeline, and whether any silicon actually ships remain unknown.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若屬實，顯示 Anthropic 在探索 NVIDIA 以外路徑，但未做成巨型收購。缺乏官方確認，交易結構、時程與是否真有晶片落地皆未知。
items_flat.quote: Anthropic discussed buying artificial intelligence chip startup MatX for roughly $7 billion, seeking to accelerate efforts to develop custom hardware for its fast-growing AI business, two people briefed on the matter told Reuters.
items_flat.quote_zh: 兩名知情人士告訴路透，Anthropic曾討論以約70億美元收購AI晶片新創MatX，以加速為快速成長的AI業務開發客製化硬體。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 開放 Model Hardware Standard 研究預覽
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a specification for AI agents to operate programmable lab and manufacturing devices. It said MHS is model-agnostic, is being shared first with science and manufacturing partners to build safety evaluations, and is planned for later open-source release. Early partners cited uses from protein assays to quantum-laser lock recovery.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，規範 AI 代理操作可程式化實驗室與製造設備。公司稱 MHS 與模型無關，先與科學與製造夥伴共享以建立安全評估，之後計劃開源。早期夥伴舉例涵蓋蛋白質檢測到量子雷射鎖定恢復。
items_flat.analysis_en: MHS is an interface bet that agentic AI will move from screens into instruments. The preview does not yet prove safe unsupervised control of physical hardware.
items_flat.analysis_zh: MHS 是押注代理式 AI 將從螢幕走進儀器的介面標準。研究預覽尚不能證明可安全、無監督地控制實體硬體。
items_flat.quote: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正向第一批科學實驗室與先進製造商開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是一套讓 AI 代理安全操作實體裝置的共用規格。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens Claude for Teachers to U.S. schools and districts
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 向美國學校與學區開放 Claude for Teachers
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said Claude for Teachers is now a free Enterprise offering for U.S. K-12 schools and districts, with SSO, role-based access, domain claiming, and a year of free access for qualifying organizations that sign up by June 30, 2027. The package includes teaching skills mapped to standards in all 50 states; Anthropic says it will not train on those conversations. Two new skills and a Detroit Public Schools pilot were also announced.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude for Teachers 成為美國 K-12 學校與學區的免費 Enterprise 方案，含 SSO、角色權限、網域認領；符合資格且於 2027 年 6 月 30 日前註冊者可獲一年免費使用。方案含對應全美 50 州課綱的教學技能；公司稱不會用這些對話訓練模型。另公布兩項新技能與底特律公立學區試點。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is education go-to-market and governance packaging, not a model launch. Impact hinges on district adoption, FERPA-aligned operations, and whether classroom outcomes are measured beyond sign-ups.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是教育市場與治理包裝，而非模型發表。影響取決於學區採用、符合 FERPA 的營運，以及課堂成效是否能超越註冊數被量測。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, Claude for Teachers is available to schools and districts as a free Enterprise offering.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，Claude for Teachers 以免費 Enterprise 方案提供給學校與學區。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI and Thailand launch an eight-week AI startup accelerator
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與泰國推出八週 AI 新創加速器
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced with Thailand’s Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation an eight-week OpenAI x MHESI AI Accelerator for ten health, wellness, and education startups. Each team receives US$2,000 in API credits, mentoring, and access to current frontier models. OpenAI called it its first public-private startup partnership with the Thai government.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 與泰國高等教育、科學、研究與創新部宣布為期八週的 OpenAI x MHESI AI 加速器，收錄十家健康、保健與教育新創。每隊獲 2,000 美元 API 額度、導師與現有前沿模型使用權。OpenAI 稱這是其與泰國政府的首個公私協力新創計畫。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is geographic go-to-market and talent cultivation, not a model launch. The credit amount is small; whether the cohort produces durable products is the test.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是區域市場進入與人才培育，而非模型發表。額度金額不大，真正考驗是這一屆能否做出可持久的產品。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI and Thailand’s Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation are launching an eight-week accelerator to help startups turn promising ideas into products ready for real-world use.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI 與泰國高等教育、科學、研究與創新部正推出為期八週的加速器，協助新創把有潛力的構想做成可實際使用的產品。

anthropic.analysis_en: This is education go-to-market and governance packaging, not a model launch. Impact hinges on district adoption, FERPA-aligned operations, and whether classroom outcomes are measured beyond sign-ups.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是教育市場與治理包裝，而非模型發表。影響取決於學區採用、符合 FERPA 的營運，以及課堂成效是否能超越註冊數被量測。
anthropic.quote: Starting today, Claude for Teachers is available to schools and districts as a free Enterprise offering.
anthropic.quote_zh: 即日起，Claude for Teachers 以免費 Enterprise 方案提供給學校與學區。

google.title_en: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with production video controls
google.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，加入可導向的影片控制
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash for developers via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. New controls include scene extension with up to 10 seconds of prior context (clips extend in 10-second steps to 40 seconds), first/last-frame interpolation, 360p draft mode, 4K upscaling, and up to three seconds of video reference. The model is rolling out across AI Studio, the Gemini app for subscribers, Flow, and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 透過 Gemini API 與 Google AI Studio 向開發者推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash。新控制包含最多 10 秒前上下文的場景延展（以 10 秒為單位延至 40 秒）、首尾幀插值、360p 草稿、4K 升頻，以及最多 3 秒影片參考。模型正推廣至 AI Studio、訂戶版 Gemini App、Flow 與 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform。
google.analysis_en: This is a tooling upgrade to make generative video directable, not a new text-reasoning flagship. Adoption depends on whether 10-second context and 4K upscaling hold continuity in real production workflows.
google.analysis_zh: 這是讓生成影片更可導向的工具升級，並非新的文本推理旗艦。能否普及取決於 10 秒上下文與 4K 升頻在真實產線上能否維持連貫。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, a new suite of creative controls and generative video capabilities to support developers.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，為開發者提供一套新的創意控制與生成影片能力。

frontier_other.title_en: Reports: NVIDIA agreed to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion
frontier_other.title_zh: 媒體：NVIDIA 同意以約 129 億美元收購 Hugging Face
frontier_other.summary_en: Reuters and The Information reported that NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion. Neither company issued a confirming statement on their official news channels in this window. Business Insider separately said talks at a similar valuation had not produced a signed agreement and could still collapse.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 路透與 The Information 報導 NVIDIA 同意以約 129 億美元收購 Hugging Face。兩家公司在本時段官方新聞渠道均未發表確認聲明。Business Insider 另稱相近估值的談判尚未簽署協議，仍可能破局。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Treat as unconfirmed until NVIDIA or Hugging Face posts. A close would raise governance questions about open-weight distribution sitting inside a chip vendor; talks can still collapse.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 在 NVIDIA 或 Hugging Face 官方發文前應視為未證實。若成交，開源權重分發落入晶片供應商將帶來治理問題；談判仍可能失敗。
frontier_other.quote: Nvidia has agreed to buy Hugging Face, a repository of open-source AI models, for $12.9 billion, The Information reported on Wednesday, citing a person with knowledge of the deal.
frontier_other.quote_zh: The Information週三引述知情人士向路透報導，NVIDIA已同意以129億美元收購開源AI模型平台Hugging Face。

brief_en: A U.S. judge voided the Pentagon’s Anthropic blacklist as unlawful retaliation. Anthropic published automated alignment-research results and opened Claude for Teachers to U.S. districts. Google’s Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video controls remain the day’s product ship. NVIDIA–Hugging Face and Anthropic–MatX stay unconfirmed press reports.
brief_zh: 美法官裁定五角大廈將 Anthropic 列供應鏈風險違法。Anthropic 發布自動化對齊研究成果，並向美國學區開放 Claude for Teachers。Google Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 為當日產品更新。NVIDIA 收購 Hugging Face、Anthropic–MatX 仍屬未證實報導。
